terrain.source: ACT 2020 LiDAR-derived 2m contours; linear Delaunay interpolation
terrain.projection: Local equirectangular metres; x east, z south
terrain.note: Resampled contour terrain, not a native DEM or surveyed road/deck heights. Water interiors interpolate shore contours; no bathymetry claim.

validation.note: Held-out contour numerical consistency, not independent survey accuracy.
